en: Itivuttaka 32 Dukanipāta, Paṭhamavagga Thus it was said. In this connection, these two verses were spoken by the Blessed One: "Those who have abandoned the five lower fetters, And for whom the five higher fetters have been destroyed, They, having become mind-made (manomaya), Are born spontaneously and attain final Nibbāna there. "Those who have abandoned the five lower fetters, And for whom the five higher fetters have been destroyed, They, having become mind-made, Are born spontaneously and attain final Nibbāna there. Thus it was said. In this connection, these two verses were spoken by the Blessed One. Now, this was said by the Blessed One, and regarding this, it was said: "Those who have abandoned the five lower fetters... and so on, as before. This is the first sutta in the second chapter of the second collection.
Thus it was said by the Blessed One; so I have heard:
"Monks, a person endowed with two qualities is deposited in hell as if carried there."
By evil conduct and by evil view.
Possessing these two qualities, monks, a person is placed in hell as if carried there."
The Blessed One spoke this matter.
In this regard, it is said:
the person who is possessed of these two qualities—
"With the breakup of the body, the one of poor wisdom is reborn in hell.
This matter was also spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
